preconditions.description: The number of teams must be a power of 2, with k between 1 and 18.
The length of the string s must be exactly 2^k - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s must be either '0', '1', or '?'.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.
Each query must have a valid index p and a valid character c.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of possible winners f(s) after processing each query.
